0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGILTOCOIN_00240_TALK_ACTOR
0.description: Welcome to the Gold Saucer! If you're looking to exchange your ordinary old gil for shiny new MGP, then you've come to the right place. What do you say?

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGILTOCOIN_00240_ERROR_GIL
1.description: I'm sorry, but it seems you lack the necessary funds to conduct the transaction. Might I suggest checking your coinpurse for holes?

2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGILTOCOIN_00240_ERROR_COIN_MAX
2.description: Oh ho! It would seem you're already carrying a sizable sum of MGP, dear customer. If you're looking for more, you'll have to earn it for yourself!

3.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGILTOCOIN_00240_ERROR_COIN_MAX_SYSTEM_000
3.description: Use of the exchange service is restricted to patrons with less than 500 MGP in their possession.

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCGILTOCOIN_00240_ERROR_COIN_MAX_SYSTEM_001
4.description: Additional MGP may be won from the numerous events and attractions available in the Gold Saucer. May the Spinner smile upon you!
